corrective.method: Three state keys: exact native original-cage local joint smoothing mapped by inverse unit DQ rotation, plus one smoothly feathered posterior flank pocket per key. No global smoothing, helper, weight or Basis edit.

keys.name: JointNeutral
keys.method: Original-resolution native CorrectiveSmooth displacement retained only in compact whole-knee and shoulder/elbow neighborhoods. No dome, topology, weight change or global smoothing.

keys.name: JointRightCross
keys.method: Original-resolution native CorrectiveSmooth displacement retained only in compact whole-knee and shoulder/elbow neighborhoods. No dome, topology, weight change or global smoothing.

keys.name: JointLeftCross
keys.method: Original-resolution native CorrectiveSmooth displacement retained only in compact whole-knee and shoulder/elbow neighborhoods. No dome, topology, weight change or global smoothing.

flank_guard.source_bounds: Posterior sourceY>15mm, |sourceX|40..260mm, sourceZ1.02..1.36m; full smooth feather, central40mm lumbar strip and frozen pelvic support sourceZ<1.02 excluded.

corrective.weights: Three nonnegative partition weights [1-|s|,max(0,s),max(0,-s)]; s is sine normalized to its sampled30fps maximum and clamped. Neutral1atentry/return; pure cross targets at37.5/112.5.
corrective.normal_export: Matching NORMAL target for each POSITION target is mandatory.

native_modifiers: Armature PreserveVolume only. Global CorrectiveSmooth and Multires disabled; optional preview uses Multires only.
shape_acceptance: Primary approved actual early DQ cage; final actual GPU review remains primary-owned.
